optin.title: Want your result by email?
optin.text: We send you a short summary of your result right away. This week you get three more short emails with an insight from your report and a test that suits you. After that, at most one email a week.
optin.consent: Yes, email me my result and these follow-up emails. I can unsubscribe at any time with one click.
optin.done: Sent! Check your inbox in a minute, and your spam folder just in case.
optin.consentRequired: Please tick the box so we are allowed to email you.

checkoutOptin: Also email me tips and offers, like a second report for {price}. Optional, unsubscribe at any time.
footer: You get this email because you asked {site} to email you your {test} result.

unsubscribePage.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribePage.text: Click the button below and we will stop sending you emails.
unsubscribePage.done: You are unsubscribed. You will not get any more emails from us.
unsubscribePage.invalid: This link is not valid anymore. Reply to one of our emails and we will remove you by hand.

result.subject: Your {test} result
result.intro: Thanks for taking the {test}. Here is the short version of your result.
result.label: Your main result
result.outro: Your full report goes a lot further: all your scores, what they say about you and practical tips you can use straight away. It costs {price}, once, with no subscription.

insight.subject: One thing your {test} says about you
insight.intro: Your full report has a section for every part of your result. This one stood out in your answers.
insight.label: {dimension}: {level}
insight.outro: There is a section like this for every score in your report, with tips that fit you.

nextTest.subject: A test that goes well with your {test}
nextTest.intro: People who take the {test} often find this one eye-opening too.
nextTest.outro: It takes about {minutes} minutes and it is free.

lastChance.subject: Your {test} report is still waiting
lastChance.intro: A week ago you took the {test}. Your answers are saved, so your full report is ready whenever you are.
lastChance.outro: One payment of {price}. No account and no subscription.

bundle.subject: Your next report for {price} ends soon
bundle.intro: Thanks for getting your {test} report. As a thank you, your next report costs {price} instead of {full}.
bundle.outro: The offer runs until {date}. Take any other test and the lower price is applied automatically at checkout.
